name: lure-the-abyss-reveal-four-all-specters-all-to-graveyard
notes: Lure the Abyss (gqh3mw478q): all four of the top four cards are Specters (Mourning Veilbound, Night Barker, Mourning Veilbound, Night Barker): all four go to the graveyard, none on the bottom. Pre-fix only the top Specter reached the graveyard; the other three never left the deck.

rulesClauses: Reveal the top four cards of your deck. Put all Specter cards from among them into your graveyard and the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. LureTheAbyssExecute() pulled the top four cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever revealed (live repro on HEAD: with two Specters in the top four, graveyard stayed at 1 [just the spell] and only the top card moved to the bottom; Specters were never put into the graveyard). Fix: new MZMoveTopOfZone() helper (GameLogic.php) compacts the zone first when the top slot is a removed phantom, then MZMoves the real top card -- full MZMove semantics kept.
